== Description ==
Original Japanese [[There'll Be Hell To Pay (Japanese)|There'll Be Hell To Pay]] from [[A New Hope (Japanese)]], black-border printing. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1997.

== Source and credit ==
Photograph of the physical card from the SWCCG Cards shop listing ''There'll Be Hell To Pay (Japanese)'', <code>https://swccgcards.com/product/jpn-anh-bb-ds-there-ll-be-hell-to-pay/</code> (now returns Page not found).
